result.file_purpose: Provides application-level booking operations for creating, canceling, querying, and calculating booking-related information. It acts as a boundary between contract/DTO-based callers and the domain layer by mapping BookingDTO objects to Booking domain entities and delegating business operations to domain services or domain entities.
